questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(84, 28, 7)

(144, 48, 12)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number ÷ 3 = 2nd number; 2nd number ÷ 4 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (84, 28, 7)

⇒ 84 ÷ 3 = 28 and 28 ÷ 4 = 7.

For, (144, 48, 12)

⇒ 144 ÷ 3 = 48 and 48 ÷ 4 = 12.

Similarly, for (180, 60, 15)

**⇒ 180 ÷ 3 = 60 and 60 ÷ 4 = 15.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

‘A+ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

Based on the above, how is L related to M if ‘L – N ÷ O × M + P’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 +
 
 
–

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Son
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 

Given: L – N ÷ O × M + P 

L – N → L is the brother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0fe76a101a568bb56112cd5f872c5f7c08bbf324a49485811b30ab349f9320c.png] 

N ÷ O → N is the daughter of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e27bb9abcb92cca5c95de4c23725ec85651c5c81ba745244df0b403ffa968632.png] 

O × M → O is the wife of M.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94aecdf1cb8b3ce158f134baa6f9804bb320813ac5347d0af303865fd105fde4.png] 

M + P → M is the son of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea35449768558a206895f0f5e699653a78684a92f3ea2dde8a1f2901faf282f3.png] 

Here, L is the son of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

⇒ 36 - __**8 ÷ 56 × 49**__ + 53 = ?

⇒ __**89 - 7**__ = **82**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some laptops are computers.

No computer is a robot.

Some robots are humans.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All humans can never be computers.

(II) Some robots are laptops

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a886a1b66e714dd874afde119dbcdbce1e8010b9d83b0783b79c169cc1d8952.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All humans can never be computers → Follow (As no computer is a robot and some robots are humans. As some part of humans is common with robots which can not be computers, therefore, whole humans can not be computers.)

II. Some robots are laptops → Does not follow (As some laptops are computers and no computer is a robot. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**"
